title: Driver killed, helper injured in 3-dump truck pileup in Real, Quezon
summary: A dump truck driver was killed while his helper was injured after three dump trucks collided along the Infanta-Famy Road in Barangay Tignoan, Real, Quezon, on Saturday night.
